scores.evidence: The s3-diagram flowchart TD has five short Japanese labels that stay readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-09.png). The two-column tables s2-table, s3-table, s4-table and pr-answer fit the phone width without clipping, and s2-code and pr-code show every line on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-07.png, pages/mobile-jp-22.png).

No screen is text-only, and the desktop line length has a median of 39 characters (target 30-40, max 53). In the practice section, two steps lists, two prompts, a checklist and a table come one after another and fill about eight phone screens (pages/mobile-jp-21.png to pages/mobile-jp-27.png) with no heading to break them up.

All text, diagram labels and UI copy are Japanese, as expected for a JP-only lesson. Contrast is good on the callout, quiz and prompt cards, s3-diagram has an alt text, and no controls sit under the top or bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-11.png, pages/mobile-jp-19.png).

niceToHave: Objective o1 breaks as 「見分」/「け、」 at 390 px in the objectives card and again in the reflection card, because 「/clear・/compact・サブエージェント」 has no break point (pages/mobile-jp-01.png, pages/mobile-jp-33.png). Writing it as 「/clear、/compact、サブエージェントのどれで対処するかを選べる」 would give the line more places to wrap.

The practice section (pr-steps-start to pr-answer) runs about eight phone screens with no subheading. A short markdown line such as 「後半：/context と /compact を試す」 before pr-code would mark where the second half starts (pages/mobile-jp-21.png).
pr-answer comes straight after the checklist with only its caption to explain it. A one-line lead such as 「終わったら、下の例と比べましょう」 would make clear it is the answer key (pages/mobile-jp-27.png).
reader: the end banner says this is the last lesson of the course because drafts are not in course.json (pages/mobile-jp-34.png). This is a known preview artifact.
reader: the mobile full-length PNG stops at 16000 px and 13 /api/ requests failed. Both are environment noise; the per-screen PNGs cover the whole page.
summary: metrics.json shows no hard failures (no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or broken-image errors), and its lessonHash matches the expected sha256:7a183d3f582412d5. No screen shows personal data, and the diagram, tables, code and quizzes all read cleanly at 390 px and 1440 px, so there are no must-fix items. The most useful polish is to mark the second half of the long practice section and to reword objective o1 so it does not break inside 見分け on mobile.
